summary: Current main reproduces the source-level regression: the Google plugin registers the memory adapter as `gemini` with `authProviderId: "google"`, but the shared resolver only attempts exact ids and configured API ids, so memory initialization reaches the existing `Unknown memory embedding provider: google` diagnostic. Prepare one narrow fix PR; no close or merge action is permitted. Focused tests could not run in this read-only checkout because `node_modules` is absent (`p-map` missing).

actions.reason: Narrow bug-only repair is appropriate. Resolve an unambiguous adapter by its declared auth provider owner only after preserving existing exact adapter-id precedence; keep unknown ids on the existing undefined/diagnostic path.
Related Google memory-provider report, but it is a separate compatibility/defaults decision and must remain independently tracked.
Related memory regression family, but it has distinct behavior and likely product/operational follow-up.
